sources: Associated Press (Aamer Madhani and Samy Magdy), via two diplomats briefed on the warnings
fault_line: Strike after the midterms to force a deal -- or a war nobody voted for? The election gate is the argument.

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] US officials told several Middle East countries and regional allies to be prepared for potential renewed military action against Iran after next week's US midterm elections (Nov 3), and for Iran to attempt to retaliate against them, per two diplomats briefed on the matter. The diplomats stressed Trump has NOT made a final decision; he has repeatedly said he is weighing new action once the elections are over. US officials described a renewed round lasting several days; regional officials brace for a longer fight if Iran and its proxies respond, with Iranian retaliation expected to target energy facilities and critical infrastructure. The White House and US officials declined to comment. Counterweight in the same report: FM Araghchi said Wednesday on X that Tehran 'continues to give diplomacy a chance to succeed' and is working with mediators on ideas from its proposal floated last month (summarily rejected by Trump) as a basis to return to a ceasefire; the UAE foreign ministry urged the sides to 'exercise wisdom and pursue political solutions'. ELEVATION TRIGGER: major military posture change warning. PortWatch note: no new snapshot this scan; latest (2026-10-26 fetch) is STALE, observation date 2026-10-18 (Hormuz 4 transits, 7-day avg 3.7 vs 2025 baseline 85.5/day) -- NOT cited as a current figure and no claimant transit number is repeated here.
sections.what_verified: Warning corroborated by 2 distinct publisher families: AP (T1) + Wall Street Journal (T2, Oct 28 report of Gulf states told to expect a short, intense burst, Patriot battery move, munitions restock). The underlying decision is explicitly unmade in both reports; White House declined comment.
sections.what_disputed: Trump has made no final decision (both AP diplomats and WSJ); Trump denied directing talks (prior record 0500-02) while Araghchi says diplomacy continues; The Times Oct 28 notes oil exports through Hormuz have now surpassed pre-war levels, removing one Iranian leverage point -- cutting against a maximalist blockade framing.
sections.why_matters: Washington just told its allies to brace: strikes after Nov 3, retaliation on energy sites -- but no decision yet. The warning is the story; the decision is not.
sections.context: Background: NEW -- AP: US warned allies to prepare for possible Iran strikes after Nov 3 midterms, and for Iranian retaliation on energy infrastructure; UAE urges wisdom; Araghchi says diplomacy still open

The fault line our audience is arguing over: Strike after the midterms to force a deal -- or a war nobody voted for? The election gate is the argument.
